files.plugin.py:
import re
from typing import Any

HOPE_WORDS = re.compile(r"\b(hope|dawn|healing|mercy|triumph|joy|promise|sunlight|redemption)\b", re.I)
DREAD_WORDS = re.compile(r"\b(ash|decay|blood|corpse|slaughter|despair|ruin|rot|futile|betrayal|gloom)\b", re.I)

def hook_custom_metric(text: str, context: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    hope_count = len(HOPE_WORDS.findall(text))
    dread_count = len(DREAD_WORDS.findall(text))
    total = hope_count + dread_count
    ratio = (dread_count / total) if total > 0 else 0.5
    return {
        "grimdark_dread_word_count": dread_count,
        "grimdark_hope_word_count": hope_count,
        "grimdark_entropy_ratio": round(ratio, 3)
    }
